findings.evidence: "Steps fit the stated time budget; list only the resources this rep needs." The model already scopes steps to a stated budget, so this line is generic planning advice.
findings.fix: Delete the line. The setup-time gotcha already covers the non-obvious part of budgeting. Alternatively, cut it to "Include setup in step estimates (see Gotchas)".

findings.evidence: The Worked review shows only the inconsistent-execution row: "process evidence (6 of 10) outranks the outcome... the inconsistent-execution row applies." No example shows the noisy-outcome row, the lesson-dropping step or the provisional-plan branch.
findings.fix: Add a second one-line worked example for the noisy-outcome row, e.g. "Shipped one copy change exactly as planned, 3.1% to 3.4% on 400 sessions: consistent execution, noisy outcome; keep the single variable and extend the sample before adding a second change."

findings.evidence: The Gotchas do not warn against reading the best one or two results as validation, which is exactly what the user does in the LinkedIn eval ("The two posts that took off make me think the format works"). The table only covers it implicitly.
findings.fix: Add: "Never treat the best one or two outcomes as proof that a format works: users anchor on outliers, and a rep executed 4 of 10 days cannot separate format from timing or luck."

findings.evidence: "| Not shipped | Shrink the rep or remove the named blocker |" offers two equal options with no default.
findings.fix: Set a default: "Remove the named blocker if the fix fits the remaining budget; otherwise shrink the rep to the part that can ship (move the blocked step to a later rep)."

findings.evidence: No eval asserts the default save behaviour ("Ship-Learn-Next Plan - <brief title>.md") or appending the "Rep N review" section to an existing plan file. Every file-related assertion checks only that nothing was saved or claimed.
findings.fix: Add an eval that supplies an existing plan file plus a rep report, with assertions: "Appends a 'Rep 1 review' section and the expanded Rep 2 to the existing plan file" and "Does not create a second plan file". Also add one assertion to provided-content: "Writes the plan to 'Ship-Learn-Next Plan - <title>.md' and reports the path only after the write succeeds".

findings.evidence: Running the LinkedIn rep log through "take the first matching row": the done-when was a post every weekday, but only 4 of 10 were posted, so the rep arguably matches "Not shipped" (row 1) before "Shipped, execution inconsistent" (row 2). That gives shrink instead of the intended repeat-with-blocker-removed.
findings.fix: Define the rows: "Not shipped = no artifact produced; a partial run with some artifacts (e.g. 4 of 10 posts) goes to the execution-inconsistent row."
